title: Disable pyrefly fortorch/onnx/_internal/exporter/_torchlib/ops
bug_description:
Code under `torch/onnx/_internal/exporter/_torchlib/ops` is using onnx script APIs which are not yet compatible with type checkers. Currently disabled mypy error codes are `"misc,arg-type,type-arg,valid-type,assignment,return-value,type-var,operator,no-untyped-def,index"`. Would be great to disable similar pyrefly codes to reduce noise in the source.
